--d-border-radius.note: The theme knob; sm and lg derive from it.

--d-border-radius-small.note: Not defined in core; sm is half md (see definitions.csv).

--d-button-default-bg-color.note: Stays a DButton token (themes change button kinds separately); its value becomes var(--d-sys-color-background-neutral).

--token-color-border-focused.note: Check the 16 uses are all inputs.

--token-color-background-accent-bolder.note: Value is --tertiary, the base step, not bold.

--highlight-bg.note: 70%: highlight's faintest tint, so subtlest (other intents' subtlest is 80–93%; yellow needs more strength). Warning borrows it: warning-subtlest.

--highlight-low.note: Identical value to --highlight-bg in both modes.

--danger-low.note: 90%. Also the icon color of danger buttons (DButton token).

--wiki.note: Part of PostMetaData: one rule styles the wiki edit indicator and the last-wiki-edit date (two child components). Value is the CSS keyword green; see core fixes.

--mention-background-color.note: No component token: the mention mixin (mentions and hashtags) uses the system neutral fill.

--shadow-dropdown.note: menu-panel.scss redefines it locally with another value.

--shadow-header.note: The hairline is the overflow value.

--float-kit-arrow-stroke-color.note: Pattern FloatKit: menu and tooltip boxes and their arrow read it, so they change together. Default var(--d-sys-color-border-default). User tips set it in their scope.

--float-kit-arrow-fill-color.note: Pattern FloatKit: menu and tooltip boxes and their arrow read it, so they change together. Default var(--d-sys-color-background-overlay). User tips set it in their scope.

--d-header-icon-color.note: Owner HeaderIcons (header/icons.gjs renders the icon list); defaults to Header-color-icon-default (header run, owner audit).

--d-header-icon-background--hover.note: Background of the icon buttons on hover (header run, owner audit).

--d-header-padding-x.note: Moved to the Header block in header.scss (header run).

--d-hover.note: Keeps its value, so themes and the design wizard that set it keep working. --token-color-surface-hovered merges into it.
--d-hover.open: Should --d-hover keep its value under the new name, with the hovered surface merging into it?

--d-border-radius-fixed.note: Fixed 4px becomes md and follows the theme.

--token-radius-normal.note: Fixed 4px becomes md and follows the theme.

--token-radius-large.note: Fixed 8px becomes lg (double md) and follows the theme.

--token-radius-small.note: Fixed 2px becomes sm (half md) and follows the theme.

--d-border-radius-pill.note: 1em becomes 9999px: differs only on elements taller than 2em.

--token-color-background-accent-subtler.note: tertiary-400, 74%: falls in the subtle band.

--tertiary-low.note: 85%, subtlest band; info backgrounds also use it (info-subtlest).

--tertiary-medium.note: 50%; matches the subtle token in light mode only.

--metadata-color.note: Meta text is muted (settled rule); value moves from primary-medium.

--shadow-composer.open: Should the composer use the dialog shadow?

--shadow-docked-composer.note: Defined in core, used only by the AI plugin.
--shadow-docked-composer.open: Should the docked composer use the overflow shadow?

--token-font-weight-bold.note: Weight words are CSS weights, so bold is 700, not 650. Keeps the 182 literal font-weight: bold/700 declarations unchanged when they migrate; the 4 sidebar uses get slightly bolder unless the sidebar keeps 650 (see Open questions). The name was already renamed in step A; the value changes in step B.
--token-font-weight-bold.open: Is bold 700? The 4 sidebar uses get slightly bolder unless the sidebar keeps 650.

--shadow-footer-nav.open: Can the footer navigation shadow become the hairline shadow?

--always-black-rgb.note: Always black, so reads use the plain color. No -rgb twins: uses become color-mix() on black.

--d-button-default-border.note: Holds only the color now: defaults to var(--d-comp-DButton-color-border). The CSS composes width, solid and this color.

--d-button-default-border--hover.note: Holds only the color now: defaults to var(--d-comp-DButton-color-border). The CSS composes width, solid and this color.

--primary.note: Target depends on each use: color-text-default, color-icon-default. Stays as a base alias.

--secondary.note: Target depends on each use: color-background-default, color-text-inverse, color-icon-inverse. Stays as a base alias.

--tertiary.note: Target depends on each use: color-text-link, color-background-accent, color-border-accent, color-icon-accent. Stays as a base alias.

--quaternary.note: Color scheme input with no shared meaning, stays as a base alias. The themes grid placeholder keeps the raw scheme color; the engagement chart (admin dashboard), the ad plugin and the subscriptions plugin get their own tokens in the full mapping. No role is settled yet, so every use waits.

--highlight.note: Scheme input, stays as a base alias. Post and rich editor backgrounds map to --d-sys-color-background-highlight (base step); the toast text and form-kit border uses get mapped in the full mapping.

--danger.note: Target depends on each use: color-text-danger, color-icon-danger, color-background-danger, color-border-danger. Stays as a base alias.

--success.note: Target depends on each use: color-text-success, color-icon-success, color-background-success, color-border-success. Stays as a base alias.

--love.note: Target depends on each use: color-icon-love, color-background-love. Stays as a base alias.

--header_background.note: Header color scheme input, stays as a base alias. Uses map to --d-comp-Header-color-background; footer nav, crawler layout, publish page, mini profiler and avatar rings copy the header and read that token.

--header_primary.note: Header color scheme input, stays as a base alias. Uses map to --d-comp-Header-color-text-default, --d-comp-Header-color-icon-default-hovered.

--header_primary-low.note: Header color scheme input, stays as a base alias. Uses map to --d-comp-Header-color-border-default and -background-neutral (tag boxes, voting hover) (header run).

--header_primary-low-mid.note: Header color scheme input, stays as a base alias. Uses map to --d-comp-Header-color-icon-default, --d-comp-Header-color-border-strong.

--header_primary-medium.note: Header color scheme input, stays as a base alias. Uses map to --d-comp-Header-color-icon-strong (static icons and voting), -icon-default-pressed, -border-strong-hovered; crawler border to -border-strong (header run).

--header_primary-high.note: Header color scheme input, stays as a base alias. Uses map to --d-comp-Header-color-text-muted; voting icons move to -icon-strong (lighter, header run).

--primary-very-low.note: Target depends on each use: color-background-sunken, color-border-muted. Stays as a base alias.

--primary-low.note: Target depends on each use: color-border-default, color-background-neutral, color-background-default-pressed. Stays as a base alias.

--primary-low-mid.note: Target depends on each use: color-text-default-disabled, color-border-strong, color-icon-faint. Stays as a base alias.

--primary-medium.note: Target depends on each use: color-text-faint, color-icon-faint. Stays as a base alias.

--primary-high.note: Target depends on each use: color-text-muted, color-icon-muted. Stays as a base alias.

--primary-very-high.note: Target depends on each use: color-text-default. Stays as a base alias.

--tertiary-hover.note: Target depends on each use: color-background-accent-hovered, color-text-link-hovered.

--highlight-high.note: Darker than the base: core uses (admin settings, edit-category border) map to --d-sys-color-background-highlight-bold; the AI and voice plugins use it as amber text and get their own tokens in the full mapping.

--danger-medium.note: 30%, base band: color-text-danger, color-border-danger, color-background-danger. Light mode gets slightly darker.

--primary-med-or-secondary-med.note: Light/dark chooser: each use maps to a token whose value uses light-dark(). Needs token names, so every use waits.
